evaluation_tasks.post_transition: same assimilated transition state for every model

long_horizon.definition: Predict scenario-conditioned threshold-crossing probability, event hazard, and RUL distribution.
long_horizon.not_allowed_as_primary: Unlimited deterministic recursion of one short-horizon field operator.
long_horizon.survival_identity: S(h)=product_{j=1..h}(1-hazard_j); RUL is derived from the scenario-conditioned survival distribution.

rolling_operation: evaluate trigger before each next block
request inspection or stop recursion when trigger fires
update latent state and RUL posterior after inspection

short_horizon.definition: Predict latent/field state for the next one to three calibrated load blocks after an assimilated inspection state.
short_horizon.evidence: Matched FEM operators support same-regime h1-h3 conditional propagation on one trajectory only.

stop_recursive_when: hard observation innovation or data-quality gate
inspection overdue under the declared risk policy
